title: Etymological Dictionary of Latin in LiLa

description.en: New etymological dictionary by Brill that covers the entire Latin lexicon of Indo-European origin. It consists of nearly 1900 entries, which altogether discuss about 8000 Latin lemmata. Only some information about P-I.E. and Proto-Italic roots is accessible via the LiLa Knowledge Base.
